Welcome to America Evangelical University

Since our founding, AEU has been committed to preparing servant leaders who will proclaim the Gospel and serve the Church with excellence.

Whether you are called to pastoral ministry, missions, counseling, or teaching, AEU provides the theological foundation you need.
